description: This file implements a GPU-accelerated content addressable storage system for tensors and storages in PyTorch, including hashing, reading, and writing functionalities, primarily used for debugging and snapshotting tensor data.

classes.name: ContentStoreWriter
classes.description: Handles writing storages and tensors to a specified location with hashing and deduplication.

classes.name: ContentStoreReader
classes.description: Handles reading storages and tensors from a specified location, with caching support.

methods.name: lazy_compile
methods.description: Decorator to lazily compile a function with torch.compile on first call.

methods.name: hash_storage_kernel
methods.description: PyTorch kernel for hashing storage data using a custom hash function.

methods.name: hash_storage
methods.description: Generates a hash digest (SHA-1 or custom) for a given storage, optimized for GPU or CPU.

methods.name: ContentStoreWriter.write_storage
methods.description: Hashes and writes a storage to disk if not already stored, returns its hash.

methods.name: ContentStoreWriter.compute_tensor_metadata
methods.description: Computes metadata for a tensor, including storage hash and shape info.

methods.name: ContentStoreWriter.write_tensor
methods.description: Writes tensor metadata and storage to disk.

methods.name: ContentStoreReader.read_storage
methods.description: Reads storage from disk by hash, with optional device mapping and caching.

methods.name: ContentStoreReader.read_tensor
methods.description: Reconstructs a tensor from stored metadata and storage.
